questions.question: For those who are in Christ Jesus, what did the law of the Spirit of life do?

answers.text: Set them free from the law of sin and death
Made them strong enough to obey every rule
Gave them a list of new rules to keep

questions.question: The law was powerless to save people because the flesh weakened it. How did God do what the law could not?

answers.text: He sent His own Son as an offering for sin
He gave His people a stricter law to follow
He sent His prophets with one more warning

questions.question: Followers of God did not receive a spirit of slavery that returns them to fear. What did they receive instead?

answers.text: The Spirit of adoption to sonship
A spirit of service under the law
A spirit of courage for the battle

questions.question: If the Spirit of the One who raised Jesus from the dead lives in believers, He will also give life to their mortal bodies. True or false?
